crossRefs.note: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
and Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasures.

people.name: Amram
people.line: Father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam

people.name: Jehdeiah
people.line: Levite descendant of Amram during David's reign

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Shebuel
people.line: Levite descendant of Gershom, in charge of treasuries

translations.web: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
translations.bsb: Now these were the rest of the descendants of Levi: From the sons of Amram: Shubael; from the sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.
translations.kjv: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
translations.asv: And of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
